QuestInfo.name: The Fearsome Giant Lupin
QuestInfo.0: #p1040004# told you that even more #o4230101#s are appearing. How could this be?
QuestInfo.1: #p1040004# explained that one of the #o4230101#s has grown huge off of uncontrolled curse energies. This #o4230101# is now a #r#o5220002##k, and it is turning #o3210800#s into zombies randomly. Unless you eliminate #r#o5220002##k, all your work thus far will be for naught! Eliminate the #r#o5220002##k! #r#o5220002##k lurks in #b#m101040300##k.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the #o5220002#. The threat of the #o4230101#s has ended. It's all over.

0.0: Good of you to drop by, #h0#. Turns out we DID miss something, and it's a pretty BIG something. Feel like helping us avoid disaster one more time?

yes.0: It's a good thing you're so eager to help! Okay, so, I thought the whole #o4230101# matter was handled once we got the #t4031925#s back from the Maladies. However, the number of #o4230101#s continued to rise...
yes.1: Turns out there's a a GIANT #o4230101# named #r#o5220002##k rampaging through the forest! #r#o5220002##k is super-saturated with dark energy, and he's turning any #o3210800#s that get close to him into zombies.
yes.2: We have to bring down #r#o5220002##k! I know #r#o5220002##k is a huge, powerful beast, but I think you're strong enough to do it. You'll find #r#o5220002##k at the #b#m101040300##k.

no.0: In all honesty, if we don't stop this thing, all of our efforts thus far will be for nothing.

yes.0: You saved all of the #o3210800#s near #m101000000#, you know. The #o3210800#s might not realize it, but the fairies of Ellinia know how important this is. You're a real hero, now...a part of Ellinia's history. You should be proud.
yes.1: After all this excitement, I'm thinking it might be time for me to retire. Here, take my equipment. I think you'll get more use out of it than I will now...hero.

mob.0: #r#o5220002##k might be the most powerful monster you've ever faced. I know it's tough, but remember, the #o3210800#s will all fall to the curse if we do nothing. Go to the #b#m101040300##k and defeat #r#o5220002##k.
